items.question: Did you travel to England for business or was it
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“Did you travel to England for business or was it”，自然应答是“We went on a family holiday.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：B（We went on a family holiday.）。
